# Regression index

Every scenario, incident and finding of the 0.1.18 effort, with the Go test(s) that keep it from coming back. One row per item; the id is `<source>:<the source's own id>`. The guard test `tests/stories/regressguard` reads this file on every `go test ./...` and fails when a row is malformed, an id repeats, a named test does not exist in the tree, a row that needs no test gives no reason, an open, on-hold or owner item sits outside its own section, or the Summary counts differ from the rows. A fixed item whose test is `NONE` is listed under "Needs a test"; the guard reports their count (set `LORE_REGRESSIONS_STRICT=1` to make it fail).

States: `fixed` (a test guards it), `open` (not fixed yet; only in the Open section), `not-reproduced`, `not-a-bug`, `docs-only`, `process` (gate, harness or another repository; the notes say why no test here), `on-hold` (a feature or design the owner put on hold; only in the On hold section, with a reason), `owner` (only the owner can do it; current defaults kept; only in the Waiting on the owner section, with a reason). On-hold and owner rows are not counted as open. A test cell holds Go test names (comma-separated) or repo-relative script paths; `-` means none needed.

Every new scenario or finding lands with its test and its row here in the same commit.

Cause fixed: rosterProject never writes inside the session lookup (findingSession): it returns the folder's natural project id (the write in progress makes that row), or no project yet when the folder has none (the write records without a session link). Class guard: every actorMu taker goes through lockActors (wire/actorlock.go), which marks the context of the chain that holds the lock; the same chain asking again (a nested ensureActor or actor-row batch) gets E_INTERNAL at once instead of a wait, and the two map-only readers (roster's actorDone mark, wroteToMachineTarget) read through the held lock. | mergefix:1-doctor | finding | no repair for existing empty-string refs: doctor empty_ref check and doctor --fix writing null (one commit per store) | fixed | TestJourneyFoldersMerge | journey asserts empty_ref names 40 rows, --fix clears them and doctor is clean after |
| mergefix:1-clear | finding | no way to clear a ref on edit (`task edit --tasklist ""` said "nothing to change") | fixed | TestJourneyFoldersMerge | new `task edit --clear-tasklist` beside the other --clear-* flags |
| mergefix:1-linked | finding | doctor in a repo linked to a store folder by its remote stopped at one note and skipped the store checks | fixed | TestJourneyFoldersMerge | the journey runs doctor from the linked client repo and gets empty_ref |
| mergefix:2 | finding | bulk operations made one store commit and push per row (merge 10 s/row; doctor --fix 24 min for 85 links; folder remove --purge over 5 min for 1,000 rows) | fixed | TestJourneyFoldersMerge, TestJourneyStaff | merge and doctor --fix asserted as ONE commit per store/repair titled by the command; member add --from CSV one commit; folder remove --purge, trash purge and delete --where one-commit not asserted by a found test |
| mergefix:2-perf | finding | each staged edit re-read every store's policy rows and secret rules (O(n^2)); delete plans decoded every row per root | fixed | TestStageReadsSettingsOnce | measured only (1,000-row merge 11 s, doctor --fix 9 s, purge 3.5 s); no timing guard found |
| mergefix:3 | finding | a bulk merge that hit one bad row stopped everything instead of writing the rest and listing what was left | fixed | TestActorMergeBulk | bad row listed with code, reason and fix, E_REFUSED, rerun "wrote 0 rows", fixed row then lands |
| mergefix:4 | finding | merge dry run named the wrong stores ("stores read: repo, <org>, <org>/org") for rows living in a folder of the org's second store | fixed | TestJourneyFoldersMerge | names the store that holds each folder with per-folder counts; asserts never the old label |
| mergefix:5 | finding | `store folder list` headed the second store's block with the first store's name and printed the block twice | fixed | TestJourneyFoldersMerge | each heading once with its own folders |
| mergefix:6 | finding | after a merge the old actor id stays in created_by/updated_by history stamps without the output saying so | fixed | TestJourneyFoldersMerge, TestActorMergeBulk | output says "history stamps keep <old>; reads show <new>"; --created-by follows merged_into; merged_into written to the org roster |
| mergefix:7 | finding | an invite could not carry team membership; `team member add` for a pending invitee was E_NOT_FOUND | fixed | TestJourneyTeamLeadTeam | `team invite --team`, pending recorded on the invite, team list/show show pending, applied at join |
| mergefix:8 | finding | the only way to put own staff on the roster was an outsider-style invite with a pasted code | fixed | TestJourneyStaff | new member add/list/show/edit/remove, --from CSV/JSON in one commit, org-level --role, teams/projects at once |

| mergefix:8-nonmember-writes | finding | a person not on the roster joining by store url was registered as an actor by org import before the refusal | fixed | TestJoinMemberRefusedFirst | left open in this round, fixed later (no actor row, no push, org entry removed) |

## lore-migfix

| id | kind | title | state | guarding test(s) | notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| migfix:1 | finding | no bulk id-keeping import: moving a v0.1.17 repo into a store folder took one `move` per row (~25 s per row, ~6 min per row in a 5k-row repo), so a 5k-row repo with live-ref-only tasks could not be moved | fixed | TestJourneyFoldersAdopt, TestStoreAdopt, TestStoreAdoptRefusals | new `lore store adopt <store>/<folder> [--from] [--remove-source] [--dry-run]`: one commit, ids/HLCs/relations kept, idempotent, source untouched; journey: 5,000-row fixture + 20 live tasks + agent-stamped mission adopted under a 60 s budget, rerun no-op, linked client repo finds rows; TestStoreAdopt break-verified |
| migfix:1-perf | finding | one `move` on a 5k-row repo took minutes: cache FTS delete by unindexed columns scanned every FTS row once per applied row (O(N²)), re-run after every live-ref write | fixed | TestFTSFollowsItsRow, TestJourneyFoldersAdopt | FTS rows keyed by the typed row's rowid, upserts keep it, cache layout v4; refresh ~4 s, move ~1–2 s |
| migfix:1-dec | finding | design choice: adopt as a store op rather than `lore move --all` (move is a per-row edit with new HLC and tombstones; adopt copies as is) | process | - | reason recorded in the op's source |
| migfix:2 | finding | `migrate run` refused a v0.1.17 live row whose HLC actor is the bare writer "agent" (E_INVALID_INPUT ... hlc actor) | fixed | TestMigrateLiveAgentWriter, TestLiveStamp | bare writer mapped to a stable actor id; report line names the mapping; damaged act_ ids still refused |
| migfix:3 | finding | a v0.1.17 per-repo gitignored lore.db was ignored: `migrate status` counted 0 rows and `migrate run` imported nothing | fixed | TestMigrateRepoLoreDB, TestMigrateRepoLoreDBProject | read read-only; status counts pending rows; never read once a format-2 row exists (no resurrection of purged rows); several projects → E_INVALID_INPUT naming them |
| migfix:4 | finding | a read command (`task list`) in a v0.1.17 repo rewrote the tracked .gitignore ("re-included .lore/data ... commit it") | fixed | TestReadsLeaveAV017RepoAlone | 17 read commands leave git status and every file byte-identical; doctor reports the fix; doctor --fix rewrites keeping the person's lines; break-verified |
| migfix:5 | finding | `store init` with a local bare repo as file:// was refused and the hint redacted the middle of a plain local path (session-id-shaped folder), so the suggested command was unusable | fixed | TestMaskMatrix, TestCampaignSync_StoreInitBareRepoAsFolder | still refused with the exact reason; hint gives a working insteadOf spelling; plain local paths never masked |
| migfix:n1 | finding | `store adopt` also copies the repo's policy rows (e.g. context targets) into the folder | not-a-bug | TestStoreAdopt | per brief "all of .lore/data"; projects, repos, folded entity_tags, machine-local and unknown tables skipped and listed |
| migfix:g1 | finding | check:fast run 1: docs examples showed the new .gitattributes notice in converted shared-database repos | process | - | docs transcript drift; the docs-examples gate step compares them |
| migfix:g2 | finding | after-land run 1 failed: `store adopt` neither swept nor listed as not user-run in the command sweep | fixed | TestSweepCoversEveryCommand | listed with its reason; re-landed; after-land PASS |
| migfix:al | scenario | full after-land gate on the landed commit | process | - | task check:after-land PASS after the sweep fix |
| migfix:n2 | finding | a full cache refresh of 5,000 rows still takes ~3–4 s, mostly per-row statement preparation | fixed | TestRefreshPreparesOncePerStatement | bounded; a per-transaction statement cache would cut it; not required by the brief |
